classification.difficultyReason: Represent the equal base and perpendicular height by one variable, apply the triangle area formula, take a square root and select the positive length.

content.prompt: A large triangular road sign with base length equal to its height has an area of $1800\text{ cm}^2$. Find the length of the base.

answer.worked:
Let the base and perpendicular height each be $x$ cm, where $x>0$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac12 x^2&=1800\\x^2&=3600\\x&=\pm60\end{align*}$$
Reject $x=-60$ because a length is positive. The base is $60\text{ cm}$.

spec.description: Authored schematic triangle with base and perpendicular height both labelled x cm; the dashed altitude has a right-angle mark. No equal-side assumption is made.
